name: Frankenstrike
abilities: Bio-electrokinesis from back-mounted conductor coils (lightning-bolt discharges, beams, surface waves)
Immense strength (tears steel, lifts a tank)
Immense durability (walks through bullets and tank shells)
Technokinesis / merging with and powering machinery
Space survivability; heat and wind resistance
weaknesses: Energy can be drained through his shoulder generators (Phil)
Cannot conduct or absorb external electricity
Can be controlled by Vladat Corrupturas
Can be scared by Toepick's species
summary: Ben's Frankenstein: a seven-foot stitched-together Transylian who fires lightning from bio-metallic coils and hits like a truck.
traits: Conductor towers are organic growths, not machines
notableFeats: Fought Zs'Skayr and the Mummy on a space station and hurled Dr. Viktor into a portal (Be Afraid of the Dark)
Beat the Circus Freaks and zombie clowns (Something Zombozo This Way Comes)
Fought a Techadon robot chasing Rojo (The Color of Monkey)

appearances.designNotes: Long mullet with pointed sideburns, two-tone greyish-yellow skin, brown gauntlets and conductor coils, black pants, green boot slits, belt with the original Omnitrix as the clasp.

Short hair with mutton-chop sideburns, dark grey stitched skin patches, large copper bolts with green lines, deep-green coils with white spirals on the shoulders, green belt/gauntlets, copper boots, uneven yellowed teeth, Omnitrix embedded in the right pectoral.

scoring.rationale: Heavy hitter who tanks tank shells and throws lightning that punches holes in starships, with tech-merging utility. Slow-ish and oversized, and an energy-drainer like Phil can empty his coils.

notes: Not used in Alien Force (locked) or Ultimate Alien (intro only; re-unlocked in Ben 10,000 Returns).
Also used by Benzarro (And Then There Were None / And Then There Was Ben) - not counted.
Editorial score calibration (principal pass): energy 7→6, offense 7→6, durability 8→7 — to keep the roster ladder consistent across research batches.
